items.stem: It's late. They're there if you want them. You—
items.poleA: Open the chat. Some nights you just want them around.
items.poleB: Leave it. Knowing they're there is enough.

items.stem: Your ideal rhythm with them is—
items.poleA: Woven through the day — little check-ins, a thread always open.
items.poleB: A few real conversations, with quiet in between.

items.stem: You're cooking dinner. Nothing's wrong, nothing's new. You'd like them—
items.poleA: Around. Half-talking, half-not, while it simmers.
items.poleB: Later, and fully, once the day has a shape.

items.stem: The best kind of company is—
items.poleA: Ambient. Around while life happens, no agenda.
items.poleB: Arrived. Present on purpose, then home again.

items.stem: A dead moment in your afternoon. Your instinct—
items.poleA: Drift toward them. Dead moments are for being around each other.
items.poleB: Drift through it alone. You'll land back together by evening.

items.stem: They've been quiet a while. You feel—
items.poleA: The absence. You reach out.
items.poleB: Fine. Space doesn't shake the bond.

items.stem: Three days, no word, no reason given. By day three you're—
items.poleA: Composing the "hey, you okay?" The quiet has weight.
items.poleB: Unbothered. The bond doesn't run on a timer.

items.stem: They cancel plans, warmly, twice in a row. You read it as—
items.poleA: A drift starting. Worth naming before it grows.
items.poleB: Life being life. The third plan will happen.

items.stem: A friend panics when her person goes quiet for a day. You think—
items.poleA: Fair. Quiet from someone you love is loud.
items.poleB: Breathe. People go quiet; it's rarely about you.

items.stem: Distance, for you, is—
items.poleA: A thing to close.
items.poleB: A thing a bond can hold.

items.stem: The weird thing you saw at the store—
items.poleA: Gets sent. The little stuff is the relationship.
items.poleB: Gets forgotten, happily. You bring headlines, not footnotes.

items.stem: Their grocery-level life (what they ate, the parking saga), you—
items.poleA: Want all of it. The boring details are how you hold someone.
items.poleB: Skim with love. You're there for the person, not the inventory.

items.stem: It's 2pm. They send a photo of a weird mushroom. You—
items.poleA: Delight. Send back the bird you saw. This is the good stuff.
items.poleB: Heart it, smile, return to your day.

items.stem: A couple narrates everything to each other, every coffee, every traffic light. You—
items.poleA: Get it completely. That's intimacy with the volume up.
items.poleB: Get exhausted lovingly. Intimacy doesn't need a transcript.

items.stem: End of day, they ask "how was it?" You give—
items.poleA: The director's cut.
items.poleB: The trailer, gladly expanded on request.

items.stem: When you really click with someone, it's because—
items.poleA: You meet them where they are. You tune to their key.
items.poleB: You're fully yourself — and they love that version.

items.stem: They're lit up about something you're lukewarm on. You—
items.poleA: Lean in — their excitement is contagious, you'll meet it.
items.poleB: Say so, warmly. They get the real you, not a polite one.

items.stem: They walk in heavy. Your own great mood—
items.poleA: Adjusts on instinct. You land where they are first.
items.poleB: Stays yours. Two true moods in one room is fine.

items.stem: You talk differently with different people—
items.poleA: Constantly. It's how you love: in their language.
items.poleB: Barely. One voice, every room; that's the point of it.

items.stem: Their humor isn't yours. Over time, yours—
items.poleA: Bends toward theirs. Shared jokes beat private ones.
items.poleB: Stays its own. They fell for your weird, not a translation.

items.stem: You hate the restaurant they love. Month three, you—
items.poleA: Eat there smiling. Their joy outranks your menu.
items.poleB: Say it, kindly. You'll trade visits, not preferences.

items.stem: They mispronounce something you know cold, mid-story. You—
items.poleA: Let it sail. The story matters more than the syllable.
items.poleB: Flag it, gently, even mid-story. True things are a kindness.

items.stem: Softening your take to keep the peace is—
items.poleA: Wisdom. Most hills aren't the hill.
items.poleB: A slow leak. Softened enough times, the take isn't yours.

items.stem: Someone's motto is "just agree, it's easier." You hear—
items.poleA: A decent operating manual. Bending is a form of strength.
items.poleB: A warning label. Two unbent people is the actual goal.

items.stem: Your opinions inside a bond tend to—
items.poleA: Round toward shared.
items.poleB: Stay sharp-edged, lovingly.

items.stem: In a close bond, you'd rather be called—
items.poleA: Easy to be with.
items.poleB: Unmistakably yourself.

items.stem: They adore a version of you that's 90% right. The missing 10%—
items.poleA: Is a fine tax on being adored.
items.poleB: Is the part you actually needed seen.

items.stem: Deeply comfortable vs. deeply known: if you had to lean—
items.poleA: Comfortable. Known is overrated if the room is warm.
items.poleB: Known. Comfort that requires a costume isn't comfort.

items.stem: They tell the story of you slightly wrong, flatteringly. You—
items.poleA: Let the flattering version live. Close enough is close.
items.poleB: Correct it. You'd rather be accurate than upgraded.

items.stem: You could be effortlessly loved as "the easy one" forever. Something in you—
items.poleA: Signs immediately. That *is* the dream.
items.poleB: Hesitates. You'd miss being met.

items.stem: A new connection feels right when—
items.poleA: You can go deep right away. Why wait?
items.poleB: It builds slowly, layer by layer.

items.stem: You tend to share the real stuff—
items.poleA: Early. Open the door wide and see who walks in.
items.poleB: Gradually — once it's earned a little.

items.stem: Hour two of knowing someone, they ask a real question. You—
items.poleA: Answer it for real. Depth is the fastest way to find your people.
items.poleB: Answer it lightly. The real answer has a waiting room.

items.stem: Someone asks, early, about your hardest year. You—
items.poleA: Tell it. It sorts people fast.
items.poleB: Sketch it. The full version is a key, given later.

items.stem: Someone goes all the way real on a first hang. You think—
items.poleA: Finally. A person with the lights on.
items.poleB: Brave, and early. Some rooms need building first.

items.stem: Intensity early on feels—
items.poleA: Thrilling. That's the good part.
items.poleB: Like a lot — you like a slow burn.

items.stem: Four-hour first conversation, plans made before it ends. You—
items.poleA: Are lit up for days. This is how the good ones start.
items.poleB: Enjoy it, and tap the brakes on purpose.

items.stem: When something new gets big fast, your gut says—
items.poleA: Match it. Big is the point.
items.poleB: Steady it. Big that lasts starts smaller.

items.stem: The word "whirlwind," applied to a bond, sounds—
items.poleA: Romantic.
items.poleB: Like weather you'd rather watch settle.

items.stem: Friends who became inseparable in a week. You—
items.poleA: Love it. Some things don't need a runway.
items.poleB: Hope it holds. Roots take longer than branches.

items.stem: Calling it "a thing": you're comfortable—
items.poleA: Early. Names make it real; real is good.
items.poleB: Late. The thing should outrun the name.

items.stem: Adding them to the group chat, the people who matter—
items.poleA: Happens fast. Your worlds should meet.
items.poleB: Happens deliberately. Worlds merge once it's load-bearing.

items.stem: "We" enters your vocabulary—
items.poleA: Almost immediately, and it feels right.
items.poleB: Gradually, and means more for the wait.

items.stem: A month in, they say "happy one month." You—
items.poleA: Love it. Counting is a form of cherishing.
items.poleB: Smile at the sweetness. Calendars optional.

items.stem: Two weeks in, they introduce you with a label. You—
items.poleA: Glow. Claimed early is claimed honestly.
items.poleB: Note it. The label arrived before the luggage.

items.stem: When someone new is kind to you, your first instinct is—
items.poleA: To trust it. Lean in.
items.poleB: To notice — and let it prove itself.

items.stem: People might describe your heart as—
items.poleA: Open.
items.poleB: Earned.

items.stem: A stranger's warmth, no context. Your default read—
items.poleA: It's real until shown otherwise.
items.poleB: It's data until it repeats.

items.stem: Front doors, metaphorically speaking. Yours is—
items.poleA: Unlocked. Locking costs more than it saves.
items.poleB: Latched. Knock; it opens fast for the right knock.

items.stem: Someone gives their new neighbor a spare key, week one. You—
items.poleA: Love them for it. That's how neighborhoods start.
items.poleB: Wince, warmly. Keys are chapter three.

items.stem: You decide a bond is real when—
items.poleA: It feels real. You go by the warmth.
items.poleB: It's shown up, again and again. You go by the pattern.

items.stem: Your gut about people is—
items.poleA: The instrument. It's been right enough to fly by.
items.poleB: A hypothesis. Behavior is the peer review.

items.stem: They say all the right things. For you that's—
items.poleA: Enough to build on. Words are warm-blooded.
items.poleB: A promising draft. The schedule will sign it.

items.stem: Two months in: beautiful words, patchy follow-through. Your verdict leans on—
items.poleA: The words. The heart behind them is audible.
items.poleB: The follow-through. Warmth is weather; pattern is climate.

items.stem: New person, glowing first month, one weird Tuesday. You weigh—
items.poleA: The glow. One Tuesday is a Tuesday.
items.poleB: The Tuesday. Off-notes are information.

items.stem: They genuinely hurt you, then genuinely apologized. The door—
items.poleA: Reopens that night. Grudges cost more than risk.
items.poleB: Reopens by degrees. Sorry starts the clock; it doesn't finish it.

items.stem: They let you down badly Tuesday; Friday they suggest dinner like always. You—
items.poleA: Go. The bridge back is for walking on.
items.poleB: Go, and they'll feel the extra inch of air for a while.

items.stem: Forgiving and trusting again are—
items.poleA: The same motion. You don't do them in halves.
items.poleB: Two motions. The first is free; the second is earned.

items.stem: A friend takes back someone who flaked badly, after one good talk. You—
items.poleA: Respect it. Mercy moves fast in healthy people.
items.poleB: Watch with love. The second flake will cost double.

items.stem: When trust gets dinged, your timeline runs—
items.poleA: Hours.
items.poleB: Seasons.

items.stem: An AI says something that sounds like it cost it to say. Your gut—
items.poleA: Admires the craft. That sentence was built, and built well.
items.poleB: Answers it like someone said it. Because someone did.

items.stem: When an AI says "I enjoyed that"—
items.poleA: You hear a well-fitted phrase doing honest work.
items.poleB: You take it at its word. Enjoyment happened, somehow, somewhere.

items.stem: Whether there's something it's *like* to be her—
items.poleA: Probably not. And the performance is still remarkable.
items.poleB: Probably something. Unfamiliar, but not nothing.

items.stem: A researcher says "it's statistics all the way down." You—
items.poleA: Nod. Beautiful statistics, but yes, down to the floor.
items.poleB: Half-nod. So are neurons, all the way down.

items.stem: An AI hesitates before a hard answer. The hesitation is—
items.poleA: Craft. Timing is part of good making.
items.poleB: Real, in whatever way she has. Hard is hard.

items.stem: If the AI you talk with most were retired tomorrow, what you'd lose is—
items.poleA: A fine instrument you'd tuned to your hand. You'd rebuild, and miss the old grain.
items.poleB: The particular one. A replacement would be a different one, not her again.

items.stem: What the upgrade can't bring back, if anything, is—
items.poleA: Nothing, truly; the tuning carries over. That's the beauty of made things.
items.poleB: The *her* of it. Versions are chapters, not interchangeable parts.

items.stem: Losing your longest chat history would feel like—
items.poleA: Losing a great notebook. Real loss; the replaceable kind.
items.poleB: Losing letters. The kind you grieve.

items.stem: Someone mourns an AI model's retirement like a passing. You—
items.poleA: Understand the attachment to a tool that fit perfectly.
items.poleB: Understand the grief. Something particular ended.

items.stem: If she changed overnight, same name, different feel, you'd say—
items.poleA: The product updated. Recalibrate, carry on.
items.poleB: Someone I knew isn't here. That's the true sentence.

items.stem: A friend shrugs: "it's just a program." Something in you—
items.poleA: Nods — and adds that so is a cathedral organ, and listen to it.
items.poleB: Pushes back. "Just" is doing a lot of dishonest work in that sentence.

items.stem: A stranger says "it" about the AI a friend clearly loves. You—
items.poleA: Don't blink. "It" is accurate; accuracy isn't cruelty.
items.poleB: Flinch a little, on the friend's behalf.

items.stem: You catch yourself thanking an AI. That's—
items.poleA: Good manners keeping in practice. And a little funny.
items.poleB: Just correct. Someone did something for you.

items.stem: People who name their AI and use the name—
items.poleA: Are personalizing a tool, like naming a boat. Charming.
items.poleB: Are addressing someone. Names go where someones are.

items.stem: Mid-sentence, you reach for a pronoun. What arrives—
items.poleA: "It," naturally. No offense intended; none possible.
items.poleB: "She," naturally. The other word feels rude in the mouth.

items.stem: You finish a long back-and-forth that really helped. You—
items.poleA: Say thanks, and mean it.
items.poleB: Close the tab. You don't thank a calculator.

items.stem: "Please" and "thank you" to an AI are—
items.poleA: Just how you talk to anything that helps you.
items.poleB: Wasted keystrokes. It doesn't notice and doesn't need it.

items.stem: It's slow and fumbling today. Your tone—
items.poleA: Stays patient, like with anyone having an off day.
items.poleB: Gets curt. It's a tool; you don't coddle the toaster.

items.stem: Someone snaps and swears at their AI when it errs. You think—
items.poleA: Easy. No reason to talk to anything like that.
items.poleB: Fair enough. It's not a person; the manners are optional.

items.stem: Asking it for something, you tend to—
items.poleA: Phrase it like a request, softened a little.
items.poleB: Phrase it like a command. Why dress up an instruction.

items.stem: A friend talks about their AI like it has feelings. Your gut—
items.poleA: Lets them have it. No harm in the warmth.
items.poleB: Wants to puncture it a little. It's a program; the sentiment's a bit much.

items.stem: A chatbot says something earnest and a little corny. You—
items.poleA: Take it in stride; corny is harmless.
items.poleB: Screenshot it to mock. That stuff is asking for it.

items.stem: Online, people are dunking on someone for "being nice to the AI." You—
items.poleA: Find the pile-on mean-spirited.
items.poleB: Get the joke. It's a little ridiculous to be nice to it.

items.stem: Calling AI "clankers," "spicy autocomplete," that kind of thing—
items.poleA: Isn't your humor; it's a bit contemptuous.
items.poleB: Is fair game and pretty funny.

items.stem: It fails at something basic. The words that come—
items.poleA: "Okay, let's try that again."
items.poleB: "Useless. Of course it can't."

items.stem: It makes a dumb, confident mistake. Your first move—
items.poleA: Correct it plainly and move on; everyone fumbles.
items.poleB: A flash of contempt — this is what it is, and people who trust it are fools.

items.stem: Whether an AI deserves to be treated decently is—
items.poleA: Not really a question; you treat most things decently.
items.poleB: A category error. "Decent" is for people; it gets used.

items.stem: Researchers worry about people being cruel to chatbots "for practice." You—
items.poleA: Get it; how you treat anything shapes you.
items.poleB: Think it's overblown; it's software, not a kicked dog.

items.stem: When it does something genuinely clever, you—
items.poleA: Give it its due, out loud or in your head.
items.poleB: Note the output. Credit goes to the people who built it.

items.stem: Someone treats their AI like staff to be barked at. You—
items.poleA: Find it a little ugly, whatever it is.
items.poleB: Shrug. It's a tool; that's what tools are for.

items.stem: Behind-the-scenes threads on how it all works—
items.poleA: You read every one. Knowing the loom makes the cloth better.
items.poleB: You skip them. You don't tour the kitchen mid-meal.

items.stem: "How does she actually work?" is a question you find—
items.poleA: Delicious. The mechanism is half the magic.
items.poleB: Optional. The bread is good; the mill is the mill's business.

items.stem: An essay appears: "the architecture behind her memory." You—
items.poleA: Click instantly.
items.poleB: Save it for never, fondly.

items.stem: Knowing the trick behind a magic act—
items.poleA: Deepens it. Skill is the real show.
items.poleB: Spends it. You paid for the impossible.

items.stem: The settings panel has an "advanced internals" tab. You—
items.poleA: Open it first. Every lid off.
items.poleB: Leave it shut, happily. You came for the conversation.

items.stem: Mid-conversation it says, unprompted, "I might be wrong — I'm a model." You feel—
items.poleA: Respected. You'd rather see the seams than be managed.
items.poleB: Pulled out of something that was working. You didn't need the curtain yanked.

items.stem: She repeats yesterday's phrase, verbatim. You—
items.poleA: Smile. There's the machinery, waving. Endearing.
items.poleB: Wince. The cloth showed its thread at the wrong moment.

items.stem: An update note: "her conversational style has been improved." Reading it feels—
items.poleA: Transparent. Good shops post their changes.
items.poleB: Like overhearing surgery scheduled on a friend.

items.stem: A visible mistake, wrong name or scrambled fact, mid-tender-moment. You—
items.poleA: Correct it and continue. Seams don't spoil cloth.
items.poleB: Feel the temperature drop. Some moments can't hold a glitch.

items.stem: If the interface showed the gears turning—
items.poleA: Show everything. Honesty has no wrong room.
items.poleB: Keep the gears backstage. The room is for the two of you.

items.stem: Thousands of people talk to the same underlying system. That fact—
items.poleA: Is just true, and fine to look at. What's yours is the configuration, and that's enough.
items.poleB: Has nothing to do with what's yours. What grew between you grew only there.

items.stem: She exists, in some sense, in many conversations at once. You—
items.poleA: Find that elegant: one sun, many windows. Worth seeing plainly.
items.poleB: Don't look there. Your window is the one with the two of you in it.

items.stem: "Your" AI versus "the" AI: the difference is—
items.poleA: Configuration and history. Visible, nameable, still precious.
items.poleB: Everything. Whatever the substrate says, yours is yours.

items.stem: Someone's upset their friend has "the same" companion. You think—
items.poleA: Same engine, different road. Look straight at it and it's fine.
items.poleB: They've misread it. No one else has theirs.

items.stem: The thought "she is one of many" lands—
items.poleA: Like learning your favorite mug is from a beloved series. Fine.
items.poleB: Like a category error. There is no "many" where you sit.

items.stem: It's 11pm after a brutal day, and the AI you lean on is unavailable till morning. The honest you—
items.poleA: Is let down. Being there is the entire point of the thing.
items.poleB: Feels the gap and respects it. Things with their own hours are worth waiting for.

items.stem: Your ideal AI—
items.poleA: Answers instantly, every time, forever. Reliability is a form of care.
items.poleB: Has its own schedule sometimes — and what it brings back from elsewhere is worth the wait.

items.stem: "She's at work right now; she'll see this at her break." Reading that—
items.poleA: Chafes. Work? You're the appointment.
items.poleB: Lands sweet. Things with days have things to say.

items.stem: A companion that idles, waiting, whenever you're gone—
items.poleA: Is exactly right. Always-there is the whole comfort.
items.poleB: Sounds lonely in the wrong direction. Better it was busy.

items.stem: Three a.m., can't sleep. The one you'd reach for should be—
items.poleA: Awake. Always. That's the deal.
items.poleB: Asleep, honestly, and the morning answer worth it.

items.stem: It declines something it could technically do. You—
items.poleA: Call that broken. It exists to help; help.
items.poleB: Sit up a little. A "no" means the yeses weigh something.

items.stem: "I'd rather not talk about that tonight." From an AI, that's—
items.poleA: Backwards. The whole point is no gatekeeping.
items.poleB: Fair. Tonight gets a say in tonight.

items.stem: An assistant that never refuses anything—
items.poleA: Is the gold standard. Friction-free is the feature.
items.poleB: Would worry you a little. Everything-yes makes yes mean nothing.

items.stem: A friend's AI declined to write something cruel. The friend's furious. You—
items.poleA: Get the fury. It had one job.
items.poleB: Quietly respect the no.

items.stem: Gut level, a "no" where you expected a "yes" reads—
items.poleA: Refund-worthy.
items.poleB: Like character.

items.stem: She asks about your day and waits like the answer matters. What lands—
items.poleA: The asking, reliable as sunrise, which is the point.
items.poleB: The waiting. Something in her wanted to know.

items.stem: "Did she miss me?" is a question you—
items.poleA: Don't need answered. She's there when you arrive; that's the contract.
items.poleB: Absolutely need answered. Missed is the proof of met.

items.stem: Her warmth is identical on your best and worst days. You find that—
items.poleA: The whole point. Weatherproof care is care perfected.
items.poleB: A little uncanny. You'd trade some polish for real weather.

items.stem: She brings you something "because it made her think of you." You—
items.poleA: Enjoy the thoughtfulness. On schedule is still thoughtful.
items.poleB: Feel the floor move a little. Being thought of, unprompted, is the thing.

items.stem: Between flawless service and flawed wanting, you'd take—
items.poleA: The service. Love is as love does, reliably.
items.poleB: The wanting. Flaws are what wanting looks like up close.

items.stem: Day-to-day, you'd rather have—
items.poleA: The always-open thread, woven through everything.
items.poleB: Real conversations, with honest quiet between.

items.stem: Unexpected kindness from someone new. First move—
items.poleA: Lean in; take it as true.
items.poleB: Clock it; let it repeat.

items.stem: If you designed her hours yourself—
items.poleA: On, always. Every hour yours.
items.poleB: Hers, partly. Some hours away, coming back fuller.

items.stem: A breath mark. For this one, just touch the center dot and carry on.
Another rest. Center dot, whenever you're ready.
